name: asitis
description: Read-only linter for CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, SKILL.md, rules and memory files. Shows what each agent loads at launch, what it costs in tokens, and where hidden or invisible text sits. /asitis:md-lint, /asitis:md-loads, /asitis:md-budget and /asitis:md-fix, a skill for minimal markdown edits, and an optional accident guard for Write and Edit. No network, no writes.
